facts.text: Forty cups out to the curb and not one came back short. Best coffee on the block.
facts.why: Rotzinger is the police chief negotiating with the clown over twelve hostages and demanding the bus; the film never has him ordering or praising coffee.
facts.fix: One clown, twelve hostages and a bus. Longest afternoon of my career.

fix_note.text: One clown, twelve hostages and a bus. Longest afternoon of my career.

facts.why: The guest check rests on the forty coffees, which the film never shows; the chief is outside the bank facing a clown while a hot dog vendor works the crowd.
facts.fix: Curb, NYPD / Chief R. / 12 hot dogs 40.00

vibe.verdict: A solid bar across from the bank with the clown, the exact fare gag and the BQE signs, but the coffee gag for Rotzinger is made up.
